name: Opening-auction imbalance response
hypothesis: Submit an eligible order or post-open trade according to a frozen imbalance-response model.
spec: Setup: A licensed auction feed reports imbalance and indicative clearing price before a permitted cutoff. Entry: Submit an eligible order or post-open trade according to a frozen imbalance-response model. Exit: Use auction-specific cancellation rules and a post-fill loss/time limit. Parameters to pre-register: auction_venue, imbalance_normalization, cutoff_buffer, order_type.
blocked_reason: needs a licensed event feed (earnings surprises, consensus, filings, auction or halt data) with receipt times
